description: If distinct sets in \(\mathcal P\) are disjoint and their union is \(A\), then every \(a\in A\) belongs to exactly one member of \(\mathcal P\). Excluding the empty set therefore makes \(\mathcal P\) a partition.
signature:
Setoid.eqv_classes_of_disjoint_union.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} {c : Set (Set α)} (hu : ⋃₀ c = Set.univ)
  (H : c.PairwiseDisjoint id) (a : α) : ∃! b, b ∈ c ∧ a ∈ b
